items.title: Submit proof of use of Bauspardarlehen funds (invoice or signed order from heating company)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie den Nachweis binnen 10 Arbeitstagen nach dem Briefdatum ein.
items.computation: The letter is dated Saturday 21.11.2026 ('Briefdatum'). The letter explicitly states the 10-Arbeitstage period runs 'nach dem Briefdatum', i.e. starting the day after the letter date (analogous to §187 BGB), so counting begins 22.11.2026 (Sunday, not an Arbeitstag). Arbeitstage = Mon-Fri excluding statutory holidays. Counting forward: 23.11 Mon (1), 24.11 Tue (2), 25.11 Wed (3), 26.11 Thu (4), 27.11 Fri (5), 28-29.11 weekend skipped, 30.11 Mon (6), 01.12 Tue (7), 02.12 Wed (8), 03.12 Thu (9), 04.12 Fri (10). No NRW public holidays fall in this window (Buß- und Bettag is not an NRW statutory holiday; Nikolaus/Mariä Empfängnis are not NRW holidays either). The 10th Arbeitstag is Friday 04.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further adjustment is needed.

warnings: The letter states that missing the deadline will simply postpone the disbursement to the next first-of-month ('verschiebt sich die Auszahlung auf den nächsten Monatsersten'); this is a stated consequence, not itself a fixed obligation date, so it was not listed as a separate item.

This appears to be a routine request from a Bausparkasse for proof of use of loan funds; no unusual payment demand or suspicious third-party IBAN was found, but the recipient should verify the sender's contact details (phone/email/IBAN in the footer) match prior correspondence from Bauspar Beispielheim AG before replying or sending any documents.
